description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying {2}{W}, returning Eternal Witness to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Sevinne's Reclamation from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {W}.
Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord triggers.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Rat token, adding one mana of any color.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
